treatment.bacterial_leaf_blight.chemical: Spray copper oxychloride at 4 g per litre of water.
Avoid extra nitrogen until the field recovers.
Drain standing water and let the field dry for a few days.
Spray fresh cow-dung extract (20 g per litre), strained.
treatment.brown_spot.chemical.step1: Spray propiconazole 25 EC at 1 ml per litre of water.
treatment.brown_spot.chemical.step2: Apply potash (MoP) as recommended for your soil.
treatment.brown_spot.organic.step1: Add well-rotted compost to improve soil nutrition.
treatment.brown_spot.organic.step2: Treat seeds in hot water (52 °C, 10 minutes) next season.
treatment.healthy.step1: Keep monitoring weekly and maintain balanced fertiliser.
treatment.rice_blast.chemical.step1: Spray tricyclazole 75 WP at 0.6 g per litre of water.
treatment.rice_blast.chemical.step2: Repeat after 10 days if new spots appear.
treatment.rice_blast.organic.step1: Drain the field for 3–4 days and stop urea top-dressing.
treatment.rice_blast.organic.step2: Spray Trichoderma-based bio-fungicide in the evening.
treatment.safety: Wear gloves and a mask. Do not spray before rain or in strong wind.
treatment.sheath_blight.chemical.step1: Spray hexaconazole 5 EC at 2 ml per litre at the base of plants.
treatment.sheath_blight.chemical.step2: Repeat after 15 days if lesions keep spreading.
treatment.sheath_blight.organic.step1: Widen plant spacing and remove infected lower leaves.
treatment.sheath_blight.organic.step2: Apply Trichoderma mixed with compost around the plants.
treatment.tungro.chemical.step1: Control leafhoppers with imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.5 ml per litre.
treatment.tungro.chemical.step2: Pull out and destroy badly infected plants.
treatment.tungro.organic.step1: Set up light traps at night to catch leafhoppers.
treatment.tungro.organic.step2: Spray neem oil (5 ml per litre) and plant resistant varieties next season.
